scope: Indexed public regular member bytes only. All raw successes and failures retain actual identities/statuses. Native/hardware/human acceptance remains false. Four explicit private originals are excluded; complete descriptors and marked derivatives are public. Giant reproducible patches/envelope are separately described; no claim that every raw host-context byte is published.
